title: Ford 1914 yilda Model T shassisini 93 daqiqada yig'gan

scenes.text: Ford ma'lumotiga ko'ra, 1914 yilga kelib Model T shassisi taxminan 12 soat o'rniga 93 daqiqada yig'ilardi.
scenes.keywords: vintage car factory workers black and white

scenes.text: Avval mashina bir joyda turib yig'ilardi.
scenes.keywords: mechanics working on old car garage

scenes.text: 1913 yil oktyabrda Ford harakatlanuvchi konveyer liniyasini ishga tushirdi.
Endi ishchi bir joyda turar, ish uning oldiga kelardi.
Har bir ishchi bitta oddiy amalni bajarardi.
Ba'zan ko'proq ishlash emas, boshqacha tartiblash kerak.

description: Ford ma'lumotiga ko'ra, 1913 yil oktyabrdan harakatlanuvchi konveyer liniyasi Model T shassisini yig'ishni tezlashtirdi; 1914 yil boshiga kelib bu vaqt taxminan 12 soatdan 93 daqiqagacha qisqargan. Sen qaysi ishingni boshqacha tartiblay olasan?
source: The Henry Ford museum: Ford Methods and the Ford Shops (stationary assembly about 12.5 hours per car; moving chassis line began 7 Oct 1913; by early 1914 a finished chassis every 93 minutes), https://www.thehenryford.org/explore/blog/ford-methods-and-the-ford-shops ; The Henry Ford K-12 Research Guide: Assembly Line, https://askus.thehenryford.org/K12/faq/433848 ; History.com: Ford's assembly line starts rolling, https://www.history.com/this-day-in-history/fords-assembly-line-starts-rolling . Note: 93 minutes refers to the Model T chassis (about 1914), not a whole finished car in 1913; some sources call it man-minutes of work.
